title: The UK's NHS plans to keep its £330M Palantir contract until 2029, rather than triggering an early release clause in 2027; the deal was due to run until 2031

summary: Hugh Pym / BBC : The UK's NHS plans to keep its £330M Palantir contract until 2029, rather than triggering an early release clause in 2027; the deal was due to run until 2031 — The government says it will continue a key NHS data contract in England with the controversial US tech giant Palantir until
